subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Rosamond emptied the jar, only to discover that it was not really purple but just a plain (a) ------- glass jar. Without the coloured water, it lost its charm. She was deeply (b) ------- and cried over her mistake. As days passed, her worn-out shoes became worse. She could no longer run, dance, or even go (c) ------- with her mother. Her choice brought her discomfort and (d) ------- for an entire month. In the end, Rosamond realized her mistake and promised to be more (e) ------- in the future. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) white; (b) disappointed; (c) shopping; (d) regret; (e) wise; ● ●
